text:
Noah Rivera: Quick brainstorm: run a PLG micro-test next week pairing a 10-min launch post + 10-min microwebinar. idea is tiered credits based on engagement: read post -> $5, attend webinar -> $25. keep it scoped to 400 new signups.
Priya Desai: interesting. what's the core metric? more template adoption or faster first API call?
Noah Rivera: primary = pct_of_users_who_try_prompt_templates within 7 days. secondary = time_to_first_api_call.
Jonah Miller: routing question  how do we decide who sees the webinar invite vs post-only?
Zoe Park: rule: paid acquisition with utm=webinar -> auto invite; organic social clicks -> post-only; randomize 1:1 for remaining organic. cap webinar to 250.
Priya Desai: experiment arms?
Noah Rivera: three arms: (A) post+webinar (A1 get $5 for reading + $25 on attend), (B) post+credit only ($10 on reading), (C) control (post only, no credit).
Jonah Miller: need onboarding change to surface 4 curated templates for webinar attendees. can we show inline walkthrough?
Zoe Park: yes. I'll add FF `mkt/webinar_template_highlight_v2`. ops-bot: create flag with canary 30.
ops-bot: flag created: mkt/webinar_template_highlight_v2 (canary=30) :white_check_mark:
Priya Desai: email cadence for webinar arm: invite, -24h reminder, -30m reminder, replay + credit redemption link. include a CTA to "Try a template" in replay email.
Noah Rivera: analytics names: post_read, webinar_invite_sent, webinar_rsvp, webinar_attended, template_tried, credit_claimed. Jonah pls wire funnel.
Jonah Miller: will add dashboard and set alerts for early signal (24h retention, template_try_rate).
Zoe Park: timeline: landing + post copy by Mon EOD, webinar slide deck by Tue, flag ready by Tue noon. launch Wed AM.
Noah Rivera: owners: post copy = Priya, slides = Noah, FF & rollout = Zoe, analytics = Jonah, credits ops = finance-ops. tagging @finance-ops to confirm credit issuance.
Priya Desai: small UX ask  ensure post has clear "Claim $5" inline. avoid promo stacking with other offers.
Noah Rivera: agreed. let's keep cohort limited and monitor for abuse. if no objections I'll book a 15-min runbook tomorrow 9am. :rocket:
